goal: Let merged-main preview preparation accept a claim whose writes are a superset of the migration's structural writes, while any unclaimed write still refuses
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration edit, manual production command, or hand-edit of any claim fence
Do not relax admission or merge-outcome matching against the issue scope
assumptions: Claim object locks broader than the SQL's writes only excluded other writers and are safe to keep
The issue-scope checks at admission and merge remain exact and unchanged
stop_conditions: Refuse preparation when the SQL writes any object the claim does not hold
Refuse empty or duplicate object sets
